explain: An extracted field carries raw text, normalized value, page, region, and revision so a reviewer can inspect the transformation.
steps: Preserve recognition output before normalization. || Expose the normalized value together with its exact page region.
name: field-provenance

explain: A high OCR score does not establish field correctness. Independent cross-field arithmetic can trigger review despite apparent confidence.
steps: Compare the extracted total with reviewed line-item arithmetic. || Require review when those values disagree.
name: field-check

explain: A value without its header or footnote can change meaning. The retrievable record includes the row, unit, and qualification together.
steps: Assemble a table record with its header and note. || Render all meaning-bearing fields as one evidence unit.
name: table-header

explain: Record image-processing transformations separately from the source bytes so their effects can be compared and reversed by returning to the original. No OCR engine is invoked here.
steps: Keep original and transformed artifact identities. || Store the transformation profile alongside the recognition result.
name: preprocessing-lineage

explain: Field accuracy measures the application value, not just character recognition. Slice results by scan condition to expose weak cases.
steps: Compare extracted values against reviewed labels. || Report blurred-document accuracy separately from overall accuracy.
name: ocr-evaluation

explain: Text and image retrieval results can share source identities while preserving modality-specific provenance. The merge does not make their scores directly comparable.
steps: Keep modality on each candidate. || Deduplicate source identities before selecting evidence, without summing raw score scales.
name: multimodal-hits
ocr-confidence-validation-boundary
explain: An OCR confidence validation harness demonstrates how high optical character recognition confidence scores fail to guarantee factual correctness, and validates multi-layer deterministic business field validation.
steps: Simulate OCR misreading refund period 14 as 74 with 94% confidence. || Demonstrate how downstream RAG faithfully cites the corrupted text with high evaluation scores. || Enforce deterministic business rule validation to quarantine anomalous extractions for human review.
expect: All OCR confidence validation boundary invariants verified successfully.
